caption: The drawing features a single long dress rendered in shades of light green. The dress has a fitted bodice with a square neckline adorned with a ruffled trim, and sleeves that extend just below the elbow, also decorated with ruffles at the cuffs. The waist is narrow and accentuated, leading to a very wide, full skirt that extends outward in a bell shape. The lower part of the skirt is decorated with multiple vertical rows of ruffles, each terminating in a bow, forming a geometric pattern around the bottom hem. The entire garment and its embellishments are consistently green, with darker and lighter shading to imply folds and depth. In the upper right portion of the drawing, there is a faint, partial sketch of the back view of the dress, showing the closure and additional detailing on the bodice and sleeves in a thin gray outline. The dress is presented on a blank background with the neckline area left empty, suggesting no head or other body parts.
title: Dress
